title: OpenAI Fellows Summer 2018: Final projects
summary: Our first cohort of OpenAI Fellows has concluded, with each Fellow going from a machine learning beginner to core OpenAI contributor in the course of a 6-month apprenticeship.
body: Our first cohort of OpenAI Fellows has concluded, with each Fellow going from a machine learning beginner to core OpenAI contributor in the course of a 6-month apprenticeship.
summaryZh: OpenAI 宣布第一期研究员项目圆满结束，参与者在六个月的学徒期内从机器学习新手成长为核心贡献者。该项目展示了人工智能领域的人才孵化成果。

aiReview.reasonZh: 该内容属于早期人才培养项目总结，对当前的大模型产业进展、智能体技术或模型评测无实质指导意义。
